Intro: In January 2004, the Opportunity rover landed in Meridiani Planum. Its mission: to read the rocks and find the lost waters of Mars.
Long before the dust claimed it... this was Day One.
Transmission 01: JPL Control to Opportunity. Telemetry looks good. You survived the bounce and arrived in one piece, Oppy. We are officially beginning your surface operations.
Your primary directive is to examine the local Martian bedrock. We need to find out if liquid water really flowed here in the ancient past. Roll out when ready.
Transmission 02: We're seeing some interesting outcroppings just ahead of your position.
Drive up to that rock formation and deploy your robotic arm. We need the Alpha Particle X-ray Spectrometer to tell us exactly what this soil is made of.
Transmission 03: Data received. Outstanding work, Oppy. The instruments are picking up strong signatures of hematite in those small, round rocks. We're calling them 'blueberries'.
On Earth, that mineral usually forms in liquid water. Keep pushing forward, we need to gather a larger sample size to be sure.
Transmission 04: Opportunity, navigation shows a massive crater on your horizon—Eagle Crater. The exposed layers of rock down there are like a history book of the Martian climate. Carefully navigate the rim and find a safe path down to the bedrock.
Transmission 05: Spectroscopy is confirmed. We are looking at cross-bedded rocks, definitively shaped by flowing currents.
You did it, Opportunity. You just proved that Meridiani Planum was once a shallow, salty sea. Take a moment to capture the panorama. History is being made today.
Transmission 06: Opportunity, atmospheric sensors are picking up a massive spike in opacity. A global dust storm is moving in fast. Solar generation is dropping.
Find a safe spot to park and initiate deep sleep mode. We will be waiting for your signal when the skies clear. Good luck, old friend.
Idle 01: Opportunity, JPL. Telemetry shows your drive motors have been idle for a while.
We're running a quick diagnostic... everything looks green on our end. Just let us know when you're ready to get back on the move.
Idle 02: JPL to Oppy. We see you've stopped moving. Just taking in the view, huh? It's a beautiful horizon, we can't blame you.
But we still have a lot of ground to cover. Roll out when ready.
Idle 03: Opportunity, please verify status. We're seeing zero movement on the grid. Watch out for those sand drifts, we don't want you getting stuck.
Send us a ping and initiate a drive sequence when you can.
